Theorem
[Hsiang--Kleiner four-manifold theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0336 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field ↗ lem:pet-ch8-grove-searle-codim2 ↗ lem:pet-ch8-isolated-zero-orbit-angle-bound ↗ lem:pet-ch8-toponogov-angle-lower-bound 1. ch8:8.3.4If $M^4$ is a compact, orientable, positively curved $4$-manifold that admits a Killing field, then $\chi (M)\le 3$. In particular, $M$ is topologically equivalent to $S^4$ or $\mathbb {CP}^2$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch8-hsiang-kleiner-4manifold \sketch Rescale so that $\sec \ge 1$. A two-dimensional zero component is handled by section 3. Otherwise all zeros are isolated. Four zeros would give, after summing at the four vertices, an angle total at most $4\pi $ by section 3, but a total strictly greater than $4\pi $ by section 3. Hence there are at most three zeros. The formula section 3 gives $\chi (M)\le 3$, and the codimension-two classification yields the stated topological alternatives.

□
